# Virology (Viro) Medications
These three medications are solely utilized in [textlink="Virology" link="Virology"] to cure disease.
Immurin is typically administered first, then depending on the disease type, either Devirate (for viruses) or Spaceacilin (for bacteria) is administered until the disease subsides.
Dylovene helps to cure damage done by Devirate and is a prerequisite to Spaceacilin.
